verdict.rationale: Sentry ships a built-in AI agent (Seer) that autofixes issues, root-causes problems, reviews code in PRs, and answers ad-hoc questions about telemetry data, all documented as first-party in-product features (sentry-docs-5, sentry-docs-17, sentry-docs-23, sentry-docs-30, sentry-docs-31). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Seer's real-world reliability and accuracy, and detail on the interaction/delegation UX beyond marketing copy.
